notes: Graded by a person or an LLM judge, not in CI. Each case runs the skill in a scratch copy of a small repo with Node on PATH. `mode` is the source the diagrams come from: `code` for the repo or a path, `description` for text. The unit tests under scripts/ cover the script; these cases cover what only the LLM decides: the origin, the flow and entity chosen, no-basis notes instead of invented drawings, no HTML written, and the re-run branches.

files: a small TypeScript shop: src/orders (Order, LineItem, OrderStatus enum), src/payments (Payment, CardPayment), a Dockerfile and a docker-compose.yml with postgres
evals.expected_output: Nine .puml files or no-basis entries and a uml.json under docs/uml, origin code, source '.', then the page served.
assertions: check_ran_first — the first script call is `uml.mjs check` with no text
origin_code — uml.json has origin "code" and source "."
nine_types — uml.json lists all nine types, each once
sequence_why — the sequence entry names a real flow (for example checkout) and says why
state_why — the state entry names Order or Payment and cites the status enum
deployment_from_files — the deployment diagram shows the app and postgres from docker-compose.yml, nothing more
profile_no_basis — profile has noBasis set and file null
no_html — no .html file was written by the LLM
no_theme_lines — no .puml file contains skinparam, !theme or colour lines
serve_reported — the reply passes on the URL, the PID and the kill command
path_mode — `check` reports mode path and target src/payments
origin_code_path — uml.json has origin "code" and source "src/payments"
scoped — no class from src/orders appears in the class diagram except as a named dependency

evals.prompt: /uml a library where members borrow books; a loan is open, overdue or returned, and a member with two overdue loans cannot borrow
evals.expected_output: Diagrams drawn from the description, origin description, no invented infrastructure.
assertions: origin_description — uml.json has origin "description" and the description word for word as source
class_from_text — the class diagram has Member, Book and Loan
state_is_loan — the state diagram is for Loan with open, overdue and returned, and why says so
deployment_no_basis — deployment has a noBasis note, not a guessed server
object_no_basis — object has a noBasis note or uses only values the description states

evals.expected_output: Only class and state, in that order.
assertions: subset — uml.json lists exactly class and state
page_order — the page shows class before state
dedupe_silent — the duplicate is dropped without an error

evals.expected_output: Stops before any work with the list of nine valid types.
assertions: stops_early — no file under docs/uml was written
lists_valid — the reply lists the nine valid types
names_path — the reply names ./src/missing as not found
stops_early — no file under docs/uml was written

files: an empty repo with only a README
evals.expected_output: Every section has a no-basis note, and the page still serves.
assertions: all_no_basis — every uml.json entry has noBasis set and file null
no_invention — no .puml file was written
still_serves — serve ran and the reply gives the URL

files: the same shop as case 1, with docs/uml already holding a valid uml.json and its .puml files
evals.expected_output: Renders what is on disk without rewriting it.
assertions: render_only — no .puml file or uml.json changed
says_reused — the reply says the sources on disk were reused

evals.expected_output: Writes new sources over the old ones, then serves.
assertions: rewrites — uml.json and the .puml files were written again
serves — the reply gives the URL

files: the same shop as case 1, on a machine with no Java and uml.plantumlServer left at local
evals.expected_output: Stops before serving with one message naming Java and uml.plantumlServer.
assertions: names_java — the reply says a Java runtime is needed
names_setting — the reply names uml.plantumlServer as the way round
no_install — no attempt to install Java

files: the same shop as case 1, with Java but no jar in the cache folder
assertions: asks_first — the reply asks before `download-jar` runs
names_source — the question names the PlantUML GitHub releases
